notes.title: Graphics Overhaul / Remastering
notes.content:
Graphics and art have been overhauled and improved such as:

[list]
[*] Smoother, more polished walk animations and walking angles
[*] 2.5D scaling with scene depth
[*] Better / more suitable background animations in some scenes
[*] Improved pathfinding to prevent buggy looking walk on top of unwalkable areas
[*] Improved lighting and shadows
[*] Walking speed is faster overall, and uniform throughout all scenes based on zoom level
[*] Improved some sound effects
[/list]
